10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:70f96b44-ef29-44.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you a senior turnaround or change consultant with a sharp eye for organisational process gaps and deep experience implementing change? Do you want to shape the way AI understands and applies change management expertise, all while working flexible hours that suit your schedule? If you have 8 to 20 hours per week available, we want you on our team. About 10x.team & The Opportunity 10x.team connects expert freelancers with world-leading AI labs building next-generation technologies. We are seeking experienced turnaround/change consultants based in the EU or UK to ensure AI-powered organisational solutions are robust, accurate, and aligned with practical realities. Your Responsibilities - Review and refine AI-generated content related to organisational change, turnaround strategy, implementation, and practical change management. - Assess AI outputs for practical relevance, compliance, and effectiveness in real-world scenarios. - Develop realistic turnaround and change scenarios informed by your own professional experience. - Create scenario variations from multiple perspectives, such as consultant, client, leadership, and stakeholders. - Identify missing elements, oversights, or flawed reasoning in AI-generated content. - In short: apply your expertise to assess, enhance, and guide AI-generated organisational content so it accurately reflects the complexities and best practices of change management at scale. About You - Senior-level turnaround/change consultant with substantial experience in the EU or UK. - Demonstrated success advising on, planning, and executing change or turnaround strategies and projects. - Skilled in evaluating organisational processes, compliance requirements, and operational needs. - Independent, self-driven, and able to provide clear, structured feedback. - Available for 8–20 hours per week and quick to respond. Why Work With Us? - Enjoy a flexible, fully remote freelance role that fits around your current commitments. - Apply your change management expertise in a fast-moving, high-impact AI environment. - Directly contribute to building the next generation of AI-driven organisational systems. - Get free access to our in-house AI Academy to expand your AI knowledge. - Benefit from clear onboarding, structured briefs, and ongoing collaborative opportunities. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c90ec380-44ba-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c90ec380-44ba-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Greece. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. Strong understanding of physical-product operations, including lead times, purchase orders, landed costs, inventory, fulfillment, manufacturing, and 3PL relationships. Pro
